# Requirements Quality Checklist: Personal Expense Tracker

**Purpose**: Review requirement completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and scenario coverage for accessibility, exact monetary behavior, persistence recovery, demo isolation, and verification.
**Created**: 2026-10-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/skill:speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Accessibility

- [x] CHK001 Is “all core flows” enumerated clearly enough to establish whether keyboard and WCAG requirements cover month selection, filtering, sorting, empty-state actions, persistence recovery, and demo interactions in addition to add, edit, and delete? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025, §FR-027–FR-029]
- [x] CHK002 Is the WCAG 2.2 Level AA target mapped to the relevant success criteria for forms, dialogs, status messages, reflow, focus appearance, and target size rather than stated only as a general goal? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §FR-025, §SC-007]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements for accessible validation and persistence feedback explicit about association with the relevant control or task, announcement to assistive technology, and not relying on color alone? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-023, §FR-025]
- [x] CHK004 Are focus-placement and focus-restoration requirements defined after failed validation, cross-month edits, and empty-state actions, rather than only for dialogs? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-015, §FR-024, §FR-026]
- [x] CHK005 Are focus containment, safe initial focus, cancellation, and restoration requirements for malformed-data replacement as complete as those for deletion? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, §FR-026; UI Contract §Persistence status and replacement contract]
- [x] CHK006 Are objective accessibility requirements specified for browser zoom, text resizing, responsive reflow, and touch-target sizing at both desktop and mobile widths? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-025; UI Contract §Accessibility and feedback contract]
- [x] CHK007 Is the acceptance threshold reconciled between targeting WCAG 2.2 AA and allowing any non-critical accessibility defects to remain unresolved, including a defined defect-severity policy? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025, §SC-007]

## Exact Monetary Behavior

- [x] CHK008 Is the accepted amount syntax defined precisely for surrounding whitespace, leading zeros, omitted whole or fractional digits, a trailing decimal point, grouping separators, currency symbols, explicit plus signs, and exponent notation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003; Data Model §Validation and conversion rules]
- [x] CHK009 Are the maximum accepted expense amount and the handling of unrepresentable individual or aggregate cent totals explicitly specified? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-003, §FR-014; Data Model §Expense, §Monthly Summary]
- [x] CHK010 Is integer-minor-unit representation for persisted amounts and exact arithmetic required consistently across the specification, constitution, plan, and data model rather than only implied by “avoid rounding drift”? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014; Constitution §I; Data Model §Validation and conversion rules]
- [x] CHK011 Do input, persistence, calculation, and display requirements consistently prohibit silent rounding and reject excess precision instead? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-014]
- [x] CHK012 Are USD en-US formatting requirements explicitly independent of browser locale, with objective examples for zero and large grouped values? [Measurability, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK013 Does “every displayed monetary value” unambiguously include transactions, monthly and category totals, deletion confirmations, and demo content? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-012, §FR-014, §FR-028]
- [x] CHK014 Are amount sorts explicitly based on exact monetary value, with deterministic tie behavior defined for both ascending and descending order? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018; Data Model §Transaction View Preferences]

## Persistence Recovery

- [x] CHK015 Are missing, malformed, unreadable, unsupported-version, duplicate-identity, and storage-access-failure states classified consistently across the specification and data model, with a required outcome for each? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021–FR-023; Data Model §Persistence Envelope, §Persistence and recovery states]
- [x] CHK016 Are recovery guarantees for unreadable storage distinguished from those for readable malformed values so that preserving an original raw value is not ambiguous when that value cannot be read? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-022–FR-023; Data Model §Persistence and recovery states]
- [x] CHK017 Are the “start fresh” and first-replacement-save flows defined precisely, including the replacement contents, informed consequence, cancellation outcome, and failed-replacement outcome? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022; UI Contract §Persistence status and replacement contract]
- [x] CHK018 Is “remain visible where possible” replaced or supported by operation-specific requirements for failed add, edit, and delete saves, later successful saves, and warning clearance? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023; Data Model §Persistence and recovery states]
- [x] CHK019 Do deletion requirements distinguish confirmed in-memory removal from durable removal when persistence fails, including the expected state after a later reload? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §FR-023; Data Model §Persistence and recovery states]
- [x] CHK020 Are the content and lifecycle of persistence warnings defined, including how unsaved changes differ from recovery-required state and when each warning may clear? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-021–FR-023]
- [x] CHK021 Are concurrent tabs, storage quota exhaustion, serialization failure, and storage becoming unavailable mid-session either covered by recovery requirements or explicitly excluded? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-023, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK022 Is all-or-nothing recovery for a collection containing one invalid record explicit and consistent with the requirement to retain valid current work where possible? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, §FR-023; Data Model §Persistence Envelope]

## Demo Isolation

- [x] CHK023 Is exact demo activation defined for duplicate parameters, additional parameters, casing variants, and values other than `demo=1`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027; UI Contract §Entry points]
- [x] CHK024 Are the fixed fictional records, fixed selected month, and initial ordering documented as reviewable expected values so that determinism has an objective baseline? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §FR-028, §SC-010]
- [x] CHK025 Is adding an expense explicitly included among supported demo interactions, with the same non-persistence guarantee as editing and deletion? [Completeness, Spec §FR-029; UI Contract §Demo interaction contract]
- [x] CHK026 Are transitions between normal and demo modes defined for reload, URL changes, and browser history so that neither records nor view state can leak between modes? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-027–FR-029]
- [x] CHK027 Do isolation requirements cover initialization, mutations, recovery handling, and status messaging, including when real data is missing or malformed? [Consistency, Spec §FR-029, §Edge Cases; UI Contract §Demo interaction contract]
- [x] CHK028 Are interactions between concurrently open normal and demo tabs addressed so that demo activity cannot react to or cause real persisted-data events? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-029, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK029 Do demo acceptance criteria require evidence of prohibited reads as well as writes, given that an unchanged persisted value alone cannot establish that no read occurred? [Measurability, Spec §FR-029, §SC-010]

## Verification Requirements

- [x] CHK030 Does every functional requirement have traceable, objective acceptance coverage, especially accessibility feedback, ordinary write failures, replacement failures, and demo read isolation? [Traceability, Gap, Spec §FR-001–FR-029, §SC-001–SC-010]
- [x] CHK031 Are “100% of verification cases” and “every tested” supported by defined case sets, boundary values, preconditions, and expected outcomes so that the claimed coverage is reproducible? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002–SC-010]
- [x] CHK032 Are accessibility review requirements explicit about manual and automated methods, keyboard and assistive-technology coverage, and inclusion of dialogs, errors, warnings, empty states, and responsive layouts? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §SC-007; Plan §Verification]
- [x] CHK033 Is the browser verification scope reconciled between support for modern desktop and mobile browsers and Chromium-only real-browser acceptance, with other browsers explicitly required or excluded? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context, §Verification]
- [x] CHK034 Do persistence success criteria cover ordinary failed mutations, subsequent successful saves, failed replacement, and post-failure reload outcomes rather than only valid reloads and malformed initial data? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-023, §SC-004, §SC-008]
- [x] CHK035 Do demo verification requirements include populated, missing, and malformed real-data preconditions as well as exact activation and mode-transition cases? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §SC-010, §FR-027–FR-029]
- [x] CHK036 Are completion requirements consistent about required checks, accessibility and recovery reviews, unresolved defects, rerun expectations, and explicit recording of accepted exceptions? [Consistency, Quickstart §Standard verification commands, §Required validation scenarios; Constitution §Quality Gates]
- [x] CHK037 Is “immediate” updating quantified, and are the size and distribution of the 1,000-expense verification dataset defined sufficiently to make scale-related acceptance objective? [Measurability, Plan §Performance Goals; Spec §SC-004]
